entries.claim: JJ-1b=ATCC35889; 16SrRNA evidence places it within Paenibacillus rather than former Bacillus macerans.

entries.limitations: 99.2%16SrRNA similarity to P.validus197 is not a strain/species equivalence assertion.

entries.claim: Crude pETA23 PraA transforms PCA into a350nm product; oxygen-electrode activity32.9±1.8U/mg.

entries.limitations: Initial product assigned by characteristic spectrum; mass spectra mainly detect subsequent HMS because5CHMS is unstable.

entries.claim: Crude pETH23 PraH accelerates5CHMS350nm→HMS375nm conversion within1min.
entries.disposition: Include C4TP08 catalysis qualified as recombinant crude extract.
entries.limitations: No conversion in control on the1min assay timescale does not contradict spontaneous loss on longer timescales.

entries.claim: Crude pETB23 PraB converts HMS to HMA; NAD+ assay1.19±0.07U/mg versusNADP+0.113±0.009.

entries.limitations: NAD+ preference is not strict exclusion ofNADP+; no separate full NADP route without reaction identity. Product spectrum+GCMS mass support assignment.

entries.claim: Addition of crude pETC23 PraC to PraB mixture produces236nm OCA spectrum.
entries.disposition: Include C4TP07 catalysis qualified as recombinant crude extract.
entries.limitations: Coupled assay; not isolated purified PraC kinetics. OCA/HMA tautomer equilibrium persists.

entries.claim: Crude pC4D23 PraD causes a6.03min HPLC product with272nm maximum after10min in500µM MgSO4.
entries.disposition: Include C4TP06 catalysis qualified as recombinant crude extract; preserve enolHPD endpoint.
entries.limitations: Product assigned using known spectrum and chromatogram, not an authentic-standard/NMR identity determination in this paper.

entries.claim: pETA23 is pET21a(+) with0.8kbNdeI–EcoRI carryingpraA.
entries.disposition: Qualify recombinant assay endpoint; native deposited sequenceC4TP01=BAH79099.1.
entries.limitations: TableS1 primers unavailable. No verified terminal tag/stop sequence for assay construct; do not infer absence of tag.

entries.claim: pETH23 is pET21a(+) with1.9kbNdeI–HindIII carryingpraH; MYDVH N-terminus in coexpression experiment determines chosen start.

entries.limitations: N-terminus of pETCH23-produced protein measured; pETH23 designed to same secondATG. Native full-length proteomics not claimed.

entries.claim: pETB23 is pET21a(+) with1.9kbNdeI–HindIII carryingpraB.

entries.claim: pETC23 is pET21a(+) with0.4kbNdeI–EcoRI carryingpraC.

entries.limitations: Terminal sequence not independently resolved; no unproven maturePro1 processing assertion.

entries.disposition: Qualify recombinant assay endpoint.

entries.claim: PraA reaction mixture converts350nm species into375nm species over20min;5CHMS not recovered after acid extraction/GCMS.
entries.disposition: Annotate spontaneous parallel conversion and extraction instability, do not infer that PraH is dispensable physiologically.
entries.limitations: An enzymatic PraH edge and reaction spontaneous:true can coexist; this is not a second enzyme.

entries.claim: HPLC at initial PraD reaction time displaysOCA0.89min andHMA2.50min; both decrease asHPD appears.
entries.disposition: Preserve native reversible tautomerase orientation plus selected forward flux.
entries.limitations: Do not collapse HMA enol andOCA keto identifiers or select opposite alkene stereoisomers from an EC label.

entries.claim: Figure1A draws5CHMS consistent with(2Z,4Z), and finalHPD as the enol.
entries.disposition: Corroborate native reaction participantCPD14966; reject pathway narrativeCPD11842(E,Z) and keto product fromRHEA24261.
entries.limitations: Precise stereochemistry is grounded jointly in native chemical structures;2009 assays alone do not stereochemically resolve every intermediate.

entries.claim: 500µMMgSO4 is present in PraD assay.
entries.disposition: Record assay condition; do not assert an experimentally established physiologicalMg cofactor solely from addition.
entries.limitations: NoMg-depletion/substitution/metal occupancy test reported.

entries.claim: PraH active-siteZn model is inferred from homologNbaD and conserved residues.
entries.disposition: Do not elevate to direct measuredPraHZn dependence.
entries.limitations: NoPraH metal stoichiometry, depletion or reconstitution experiment in2009; source omission cannot prove metal independence.

entries.claim: His11,His53,His180,Glu227 conservation is discussed by comparison toLigB.
entries.disposition: Keep homolog-motif inference distinct from native1993Fe measurements.
entries.limitations: NoPraA mutational validation for these residues in2009.

entries.claim: PraI converts4HB toPCA usingNADH/NADPH andFAD-containing assay.

entries.claim: PraE/F/G functional predictions follow homology; wholecluster enablesE.coli growth on4HB.
entries.disposition: Exclude individual downstream reactions from five-step core; optional identifiedPWY5162 interface if source establishes it.

entries.claim: pBRI23 carryingpraR-praABEGFDCHI allowsBL21(DE3) growth on10mM4HB as sole carbon within10days.

entries.limitations: SupplementFigS4 not directly inspected; body reports result. Do not declare nativeE.coli pathway occurrence or directE/F/G enzyme activities.

entries.claim: RT-PCR spansA–E,E–F,F–C,C–I; noR–A product; inductions with4HB/PCA comparedsuccinate.
entries.disposition: Retain operon expression evidence and negative regulatory-target identification gap.
entries.limitations: RT-PCR supports cotranscription, not physical operon promoter binding or quantitative native flux.

entries.claim: Reporter withPraR(pPZAR) is low inLB and induced19fold4HB/12foldPCA; promoter-onlypPZA is constitutive.

entries.limitations: No direct ligand orDNA binding. Do not emitPraR inhibits whole metabolic pathway or4HB/PCA bindsPraR. Reporter experiment inDH5alpha, not native strain.
